messages:
sasha: Heads-up: NimbusCloud scheduled GPU pool arrival for prod cutover tomorrow at 10:00 PST. Need a quick final checklist: quotas, VPC peers, subnet allowlist, images pre-pulled. Who can own each item?
pranav: I filed the quota ticket (#6423) last night. Vendor replied 'quota bump approved pending PO'. Procurement has a PO in flight — @linh can you confirm PO status?
linh: PO 2026-01 created and emailed to vendor earlier today. Vendor asked for billing account ID (acct-redwood-prod) — I DM'd that. Waiting on vendor ack, ETA ~18h :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ryan-oncall: I'll cover oncall for the cutover. Prewarm runbook is ready. Who can confirm the AMI / container image list so I can validate SHAs after pull?
sasha: Image list: ml-inference:stable-2026-03-01, runtime-base:gpu-2.2. Please run `sha256sum` on artifacts after pull. Example: ```sha256sum ml-inference.tar.gz```
vendor-bot: NimbusCloud: Received PO 2026-01, provisioning pool `nimbus-prod-34` in us-west-2. Expected IP block: 10.12.34.0/26, access permitted from rdp-redwood-gw. ETA 6-8 hours. -NimbusOps
pranav: For firewall, we need to add permit for 10.12.34.0/26 to security group `sg-ld-prod` and update the NACLs. @networking-team FYI.
linh: Updated the security ticket and tagged @networking. Also added a minimal entry in the infra runbook (link: https://confluence/redwood/infra/gpu-deploy) — will expand after vendor confirms.
ryan-oncall: Quick question on capacity: vendor mentioned some nodes could be spot-backed. We should have a clear spot fallback. Can we set cluster autoscaler max-surge to 20% and a fallback model path?
sasha: Yes — plan is max-surge 20% and fallback to quantized model `redwood-mini-q4` if capacity drops. I'll draft the autoscaler config; snippet will go in the PR. For reference: ```# autoscaler patch
maxSurge: 20%
fallbackModel: redwood-mini-q4```
pranav: IAM check done: service-account `redwood-gpu-provisioner` has Compute Admin + VPC Access roles. Created a temporary key for vendor access (48h expiry) and uploaded to secure vault.
linh: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with vendor to confirm image pull credentials and AMI manifest. If we get the vendor ack before 04:00 UTC, we can run smoke tests pre-cutover.
sasha: Can someone ping procurement to push Nimbus to confirm within 6 hours? I pinged procurement in #finance but a follow-up would help.
procurement-bot: Procurement: PO 2026-01 marked as sent to vendor@nimbuscloud.com and invoice flow started. We'll follow up with vendor on priority; expect vendor ack in ~2h.
sasha: Great — I'll open a short PR for the autoscaler + runbook updates and post the link here. Thanks everyone, please drop quick thumbs up when you've done the checklist item.
